nativeBaseline.reference: consumer-chosen native host retained in the accessibility tree

library: visually remove the host from ordinary layout without removing its content from accessibility APIs
avoid aria-hidden, hidden, inert, display:none, visibility:hidden, or behavior that suppresses the accessibility tree
consumer: avoid placing interactive content inside VisuallyHidden unless an owning pattern explicitly provides a safe focus-visible behavior

notes: VisuallyHidden is not a generic visibility, responsive-display, disclosure, skip-link, live-region, or focus-management system.
